title.zh: 伊朗最高领袖发出指示：对任何敌方威胁立即作出有效且「不受地理限制的回应」
title.en: 伊朗最高领袖发出指示：对任何敌方威胁立即作出有效且「不受地理限制的回应」

current_state.zh: Iran's Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei ordered his armed forces to respond immediately and effectively to any enemy threat without geographic restriction, and to refresh target lists to cover US and Israeli assets, signaling a more aggressive deterrence posture.
current_state.en: Iran's Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei ordered his armed forces to respond immediately and effectively to any enemy threat without geographic restriction, and to refresh target lists to cover US and Israeli assets, signaling a more aggressive deterrence posture.
